summary: The frame every dashboard panel shares: a box on the card ground with a head holding the title, a quiet subtitle such as the range it covers, a stale mark, the app's actions and the panel's own tools (expand, the panel menu, an arranged grid's grip and size), then the content, padded or flush, and an optional foot. It spans part of a twelve-column grid by its own width. Loading dims the content under a bar; empty says so in the content's place; failed puts what failed and Retry there; stale keeps the content and marks the head. Loading, empty, failed and stale never stand in for each other. A chart panel and a time series panel stand in it; a stat tile (parts/stat-panel) draws a smaller head of its own on the same states.

anatomy.panel: The box: card ground, a 1px border-strong edge, radius-surface corners, clipping its content. It takes its span's columns of the grid (DashboardGrid) and stretches to the height of its row.
anatomy.head: The head row: at least 40 tall, 12 across and 6 down, a 1px border rule under it, its pieces 8 apart. With an arranged grid's tools it may wrap, the tools and actions taking a line of their own in a narrow panel.
anatomy.title: The panel's title, cut short at the end, in text.sm at weight 500, then the subtitle 8 after it on its baseline.
anatomy.subtitle: What the panel covers, such as its range, in text.xs and muted-foreground, cut short.
anatomy.stale: With stale and not failed: a clock (12) and since when (stale's own words, else words.stale), in text.xs and warning-ink, cut short, its whole text on hover.
anatomy.actions: The app's own controls in the head, after the stale mark.
anatomy.tools: At the head's end, 8 apart: expand, the menu's button and an arranged grid's tools (the grip, the size and remove that PanelToolsProvider hands down).
anatomy.tool: A square button density.control-sm on a side, radius-md, its icon in muted-foreground: expand a 14 maximize icon named words.expand, the menu a 16 ellipsis named words.menu; both titled with their name.
anatomy.menu: The panel's dropdown menu (parts/dropdown-menu) of the app's items, opened from its tool, lined up at the tool's end, 176 wide.
anatomy.body: The content: 16 in on every side unless flush or empty, filling the room under the head; with expandable, held in a WindowedPane that opens the same content in a full-screen dialog.
anatomy.loadingBar: While loading, after a 300 ms wait: a thin bar across the top of the body, the content at half strength under it, taking no presses.
anatomy.empty: With empty: words.empty in the content's place, text.sm and muted-foreground, centered, 16 across and 32 down.
anatomy.failure: With error: what failed (error's own words, else words.failed) with an alert mark, the raw message folded under its technical heading, and Retry (an outline button at sm with a turning arrow) with onRetry. The same failure as a page state's of secondary data (parts/page-state), unframed, in the content's place.
anatomy.foot: With footer: a row under the body, 12 across and 6 down, a 1px border rule over it, in text.xs and muted-foreground.

subtitle.does: What it covers, quiet beside the title, such as its range.

span.does: How much of a wide grid it takes, by the grid's own width: wide, as named (2, 3, 4, 6, 8 or 12 of 12 columns); tablet-wide, a sixth takes a third and a quarter half, the rest the row; phone-wide, every span the row but a sixth and a quarter, which take half.

actions.does: The app's controls in the head.

menu.does: The panel menu's items, behind its button at the head's end.

expandable.does: Offers expand, which opens the content in a full-screen dialog; with expanded and onExpandedChange the app holds it, as when its own menu opens it.

loading.does: The content dims under a bar while its query is under way.

empty.does: Says words.empty in the content's place.

error.does: true, or what failed: the failure with Retry in the content's place; technical folds the raw message under it; onRetry offers Retry.

stale.does: true, or since when (Updated 12 min ago): keeps the content and marks the head.

flush.does: Content that fills the panel to its edges, such as a list, takes no padding.

head.note: At least 40 tall; the title and the subtitle 8 apart on their baseline.

loadingDelay.note: ms a query runs before the content dims and the bar shows.

denseGap.note: Between panels in a dense grid; a plain grid's gap is density.section-gap.

cells.width: Its span of the dashboard grid: twelve columns of the grid's own width, panels one column apart and rows one blank row apart (none at compact). The spans read the grid's width in columns as they read px: wide from 122 columns (1024 px), tablet-wide from 76 (640 px), phone-wide below.
cells.density: The body's blank row at the top and bottom and the grid's blank row between rows of panels are there at regular and gone at compact; the body's side padding drops from 2 to 1.

panel.note: A box in border-strong, its corners by radius-surface, on card.

head.note: One row whatever its px height: the title, the subtitle one column after it, the stale mark, the app's actions, then the tools at its end; a rule row of tees in border under it.

tool.width: 3 columns each: the icon with a column either side; one column between tools.
tool.note: Expand is the maximize icon, the menu's button the ellipsis; with keyboard focus the bars beside its ends (principle 21).

stale.note: The stale glyph and since when, after the subtitle; its whole words in the status line on focus.

loadingBar.note: A cell has no half strength, so the content cannot stay under the bar: while loading, the spinner and words.loading stand in the content's place.

empty.note: words.empty centered in the body, in muted-foreground.

failure.note: The circle-alert mark, what failed, then Retry as a one-row button (rotate-cw); the raw message in the status line on focus.

foot.note: A rule row of tees over it, then one row.

hover.means: The pointer over a tool: the hover wash, its icon in foreground.

focus.means: Keyboard focus on a tool: the frame's focus outline, in ring, focus-ring-width wide, focus-ring-offset off.

loading.means: The query is under way: after 300 ms the content at half strength under the loading bar, taking no presses; the head stays as it is.

empty.means: The query came back with nothing: words.empty in the content's place.

failed.means: The query failed: the failure and Retry in the content's place; no stale mark.

stale.means: The figures fell behind: the content kept, the stale mark in the head.
stale.reached: stale true or a string, with no error

expanded.means: The content in a full-screen dialog over the page, the panel's place kept.

rest.note: In the ink of the card.

keyboard.does: Reaches the head's actions and tools, then the content's own controls.
Opens the content in its full-screen dialog.
Opens the panel menu, its keys then parts/dropdown-menu's.
Closes the menu, or the full-screen dialog, focus back on what opened it.
keyboard.when: the menu or the expanded content is open

appText.title: The panel's title; its subtitle; its actions, menu items and footer.
appText.error: What failed, in place of words.failed, and the raw message (technical).
appText.stale: Since when, in place of words.stale.

sokkel-ui: The grid is a container (@container/dashboard): a panel's span follows the grid's own width at @2xl (a sixth) and @4xl, never the window's.
Loading waits 300 ms (useLongWait) before it dims, so a quick query never flickers; the bar is LoadingBar over the body.
The failure is Problem, its raw message under an Unfoldable; Retry is parts/button outline at sm.
expandable holds the body in WindowedPane, so the content keeps its state as it moves to the dialog and back.
PanelToolsProvider hands an arranged grid's tools (DashboardArrange) to every panel's head through context; outside one the slot draws nothing.
The words are a module-private object (WORDS: expand, menu, empty, and PANEL_STATE_WORDS spread in), merged under words; PANEL_STATE_WORDS is exported.

As of b99664f, drawn in cells as proposal c4 reads it: the grid by its own width, the head with the subtitle, the stale mark (glyphs.json) and the tools, the body padded or flush, the foot; loading, empty, failed with Retry and stale.
